def transform(grid):
    g = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(g), len(g[0])

    marker = 2
    pts = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if g[r][c] == marker]
    mr, mc = pts[0]
    color = next(v for row in g for v in row if v not in (marker, 0, 3))
    obj = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if g[r][c] == color]

    if len({r for r, c in pts}) == 1:  # horizontal marker: move toward it
        dr, dc = (1 if mr > max(r for r, c in obj) else -1), 0
        edge = min(r for r, c in obj) if dr > 0 else max(r for r, c in obj)
        for r, c in obj:
            g[r][c] = 3
        for r, c in obj:
            nr, nc = r + dr, c
            if 0 <= nr < h:
                g[nr][nc] = color
        for c in range(w):
            g[edge][c] = 8
    else:  # vertical marker: move toward it
        dr, dc = 0, (1 if mc > max(c for r, c in obj) else -1)
        edge = min(c for r, c in obj) if dc > 0 else max(c for r, c in obj)
        for r, c in obj:
            g[r][c] = 0
        for r, c in obj:
            nr, nc = r, c + dc
            if 0 <= nc < w:
                g[nr][nc] = color
        for r in range(h):
            g[r][edge] = 8

    return g
